title: Free 'Lite' lead magnet linking to the full kit
goal: Use a free, useful slice (Wallet + DailySpin) to reach developers who would not pay blind.
measurable_target: Lite version published for free; >= 1 owner-verified sale of the full kit within 21 days.
deliverable: Free Lite listing URL + ledger entry of a verified sale (or a failure reason).
acceptance_criteria: Lite package contains only free-to-share modules and clearly links to the paid kit
At least 1 sale of the full kit verified by the owner and recorded in ledger.json
human_steps: Ask Claude Code to package a Lite zip (Wallet + DailySpin + docs).
Publish it free on the same store and/or Roblox Creator Store.
Track sales; record any real sale with: python3 s2e.py ledger add --type sale ...
